name: fx_a_fair_pendant
doc: fair_pendant's steps in the game started after the attract demo (fx_a_newgame): Crono walks north through the fair to the upper plaza by Leene's Bell (loc 1B7), walks into Marle (the bump, storyline 3 -> 6), and picks up her pendant (item D6, $2400) from the ground by the stall to the east.
